name: Ahi Tuna
siboNotes: Plain ahi tuna is FODMAP-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Avoid marinades containing garlic, onion, or high-FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Season with low-FODMAP herbs like basil, cilantro, or chives
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Sear quickly to maintain tender texture and nutritional value
Pair with low-FODMAP citrus like lime or lemon for brightness
nutritionalHighlights: High in complete protein (25-30g per serving)
Excellent source of omega-3 fatty acids
Rich in selenium and vitamin B12
Good source of niacin and phosphorus
